question: What is the total DGQI 2.0 (Data Governance Quality Index) score achieved by the Department of Rural Development in Q4 of 2023-24?
solution:
The correct answer is __**4.93 out of 5**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Data Governance Quality Index (DGQI) 2.0** is a tool developed to assess the data management practices of government departments.
 
• The Department of Rural Development achieved a remarkable score of **4.93 out of 5** in **Q4 of 2023-24**, indicating strong data governance practices.
 
• The DGQI framework evaluates departments on various parameters, including **data quality, standards, security, integration, and accessibility**.
 
• This high score reflects the department's commitment to **efficient data management, transparency, and accountability** in its operations.
 
• The Department of Rural Development plays a crucial role in implementing **flagship programs like MGNREGS (Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme)** and **PMAY-G (Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin)**, which require robust data systems.
 
• Such scores are indicative of the department's efforts towards leveraging **data-driven decision-making** to improve service delivery and governance.
 
• DGQI assessments are part of the government's initiative to enhance **e-governance** and ensure better utilization of data across various schemes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Data Governance Quality Index (DGQI)**__

 __
 
• The **DGQI** is a framework introduced by **NITI Aayog** to ensure that data is efficiently managed and utilized by government departments.
 
• The framework assesses departments on **6 key pillars**: **Data Quality, Data Standards, Data Security, Data Use Cases, Data Integration, and Data Accessibility.**
 
• DGQI 2.0 builds on the earlier version and incorporates more advanced metrics for data governance.
 
 
 
• **Department of Rural Development**__
 __
 
• It is responsible for implementing major rural development schemes in India, including **MGNREGS**, **PMAY-G**, and **NRLM (National Rural Livelihoods Mission)**.
 
• The department focuses on improving rural infrastructure, generating employment, and alleviating poverty.
 
• A strong data governance system helps the department track progress, identify gaps, and improve the efficiency of its programs.
 
 
 
• **Importance of High DGQI Scores**__
 
 
• High scores reflect adherence to **best practices in data governance**, ensuring data reliability and security.
 
• They also signify the department's readiness for **integrated digital systems** and **data-driven policy-making.**
 
• Such scores can serve as benchmarks for other departments striving for better data governance.
